# Security and Code Quality Guidelines
* "Focus on security and avoid unsafe string interpolation."
* "Ensure functions have docstrings explaining parameters and return types."
* "Prefer using constants for fixed values instead of hardcoding them."
* "Validate all user inputs to prevent security vulnerabilities."
* "Use parameterized queries for database interactions to avoid SQL injection."
* "Sanitize and escape all output to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks."


## Additional Best Practices
* "Write unit tests for all critical functions to ensure code reliability."
* "Follow consistent naming conventions for variables, functions, and classes."
* "Keep functions small and focused on a single responsibility."
* "Regularly review and refactor code to maintain quality and readability."
* "Use version control effectively, including meaningful commit messages and branching strategies."
* "Document code changes and decisions to improve team collaboration and knowledge sharing."
* "Regularly update dependencies to ensure security and compatibility."
* "Perform code reviews to catch potential issues early and share knowledge among team members."
